Implement.description: What an exercise needs. Machines are listed per station: most gyms have some, not all.
Implement.title: Implement

LastSet.description: The heaviest set of the last day the exercise was logged.
LastSet.title: LastSet

Modality.description: How a movement is loaded. The Chaos Engine rotates this axis too.
Modality.title: Modality

Mode.description: Execution mode: decides which timer/logger the player renders.
Mode.title: Mode

Pattern.description: Biomechanical patterns the Chaos Engine must preserve across cycles.
Pattern.title: Pattern

ReadinessIn.description: Partial update: only fields that are sent are written (health sync + manual soreness merge).
ReadinessIn.title: ReadinessIn

Tempo.description: Cadence in seconds per phase, e.g. 4-0-4-1 for the strict pull-up.
Tempo.title: Tempo

Tier.description: Training program the athlete follows (the API keeps the historical name "tier").
Tier.title: Tier

get.description: Training days just before `day` with no sets logged: candidates to make up by shifting the cycle.

post.description:
Push the cycle forward `days` days, so the oldest missed session lands on today.

Nothing logged moves: only which session each upcoming date maps to.

delete.description: Undo a logged set. Idempotent, so an offline retry is harmless.

get.description: Upcoming sessions without readiness adjustment, for offline caching.

schema.title: Response Get Schedule Athletes  Athlete Id  Schedule Get

get.description: Other exercises for the same slot (same movement pattern, available equipment).

schema.title: Response Get Alternatives Athletes  Athlete Id  Sessions  Day  Alternatives Get

get.description: Estimated 1RM per lift, from sets logged with reps + RPE.

schema.title: Response Get Strength Athletes  Athlete Id  Strength Get
Response Put Supplement Athletes  Athlete Id  Supplements  Day  Put

put.description: Record a weigh-in. The 7-day trend becomes the body weight every target is computed from.

delete.description: Erase the account and every record tied to it (LGPD art. 18, deletion). Needs the password.

get.description: Everything stored about the signed-in user, as JSON (LGPD art. 18, portability).
